segment.source: BackTop makes it easy to go back to the top of the page.
segment.target: BackTop 可以方便地回到页面顶部。

segment.source: Show the current scroll progress around the BackTop button edge.
segment.target: 在 BackTop 按钮边缘显示当前滚动进度。

segment.source: FloatButtonHost forwards commands to the hosted button, and FloatButton items inside a group inherit the host data context for command binding.
segment.target: FloatButtonHost 会将命令转发给真实悬浮按钮，组合内的 FloatButton 子项也能继承宿主数据上下文进行命令绑定。

segment.source: Set the component to controlled mode through open. IsOpen binds two-way by default and works together with trigger.
segment.target: 通过 open 将组件设置为受控模式，IsOpen 默认双向绑定，并与 trigger 一起工作。

segment.source: Setting the description property allows you to show a FloatButton with a description.
segment.target: 设置 description 属性可以显示带描述的 FloatButton。

segment.source: When multiple buttons are used together, FloatButtonGroup is recommended. By setting the shape property of FloatButton.Group, you can change the group shape. The FloatButton.Group shape overrides the shape of FloatButtons inside.
segment.target: 多个按钮一起使用时推荐使用 FloatButtonGroup。通过设置 FloatButton.Group 的 shape 属性可以改变组合形状，组合形状会覆盖内部 FloatButton 的形状。

segment.source: Open menu mode with trigger, which could be hover or click.
segment.target: 通过 trigger 打开菜单模式，可选择 hover 或 click。

segment.source: FloatButton provides quick access to important actions, grouped menus, badges, and back-to-top behavior while keeping controls anchored to the active content area.
segment.target: FloatButton 提供重要操作的快速入口，支持组合菜单、徽标和回到顶部行为，并将控件锚定在当前内容区域。

segment.source: Floating actions that stay available inside a scrollable region.
segment.target: 在滚动区域中持续可用的悬浮操作。

segment.source: Customize animation placement. Four preset placements are provided: top, right, bottom, and left. The default placement is top.
segment.target: 自定义动画弹出位置，提供上、右、下、左四种预设位置，默认在上方。

segment.source: Root element of a BackTopFloatButton component.
Content element with font size, foreground, line height and other description styles, available in the square shape.
segment.target: 内容元素，包含字号、前景色、行高等描述样式，仅在方形形状下存在。

segment.source: Root element of a FloatButtonGroup component with placement, trigger and open state entry.
segment.target: FloatButtonGroup 组件的根元素，包含位置、触发方式和展开状态入口。

segment.source: Icon element with brush, size and other icon styles.
segment.target: 图标元素，包含画刷、尺寸等图标样式。

segment.source: List element with background, corner radius, spacing and other menu item container styles.
segment.target: 列表元素，包含背景、圆角、间距等菜单项容器样式。

segment.source: Use owner-scoped styles to customize FloatButton's published Semantic Parts.
segment.target: 使用 owner 作用域样式定制 FloatButton 已发布的 Semantic Part。
自定义语义结构的样式

segment.source: Root element with the float button's shape, type, shadow and theme entry styles.
segment.target: 根元素，包含悬浮按钮的形状、类型、阴影和主题入口样式。

segment.source: Trigger element with the group's main button styles, shown in click or hover trigger mode.
segment.target: 触发器元素，包含组主按钮样式，在点击或悬停触发模式下显示。

segment.source: Change the shape of the FloatButton with the shape property.
segment.target: 通过 shape 属性改变 FloatButton 的形状。

segment.source: Setting the tooltip property shows the FloatButton with a tooltip.
segment.target: 设置 tooltip 属性可以显示带提示的 FloatButton。

segment.source: Change the type of the FloatButton with the type property.
segment.target: 通过 type 属性改变 FloatButton 的类型。
